required_taxon_sampling: At least two sampled Vitoideae descendant lineages that span crown Vitoideae on the accepted topology; Vitis is the only current Vitoideae tip and Leea is the Leeoideae outgroup so Leea plus Vitis cannot define this node
sensitivity_design: omit fossil; test the two placements from the primary description only if matching Vitoideae lineages are sampled
